Kokonut UI patterns adapted to vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript for FJORD / FLOW.
No React, Tailwind or Motion runtime is introduced.

Source repository: https://github.com/kokonut-labs/kokonutui
Pinned source commit: 3383c65c957daaaf7623393036ecabfcd5d5e709
License: MIT (full text retained in LICENSE).

components/kokonutui/ai-input-search.tsx
  Nested composer frame, textarea and stable actions row.
hooks/use-auto-resize-textarea.ts
  Bounded height based on scrollHeight; resize with draft/viewport changes.
components/kokonutui/carousel-cards.tsx
  Rounded photo-card composition, inset edge and clear keyboard focus.

Adaptation: existing theme tokens, real photos, accessible labels and existing
chat/voice handlers retained. Animation uses local pinned Anime.js.
